notes.en: 7 Sketchfab cars on roads and in the shop; drop-zone picker on a mini-map; climb through windows (E); stair safety railings; N = talk, V = camera (in car: chase/hood/cinematic); engine sound; daily challenge +200; safer summon parking; mobile LOD for heavy cars.
